title: 第七章 小东西别叫我抓到你第八章 看起来好好吃
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
掌心的温度滚烫得吓人，隔着薄薄的睡裙衣料，几乎要灼伤她的肌肤。
“又是梦吗？”
他低哑地呢喃，声音里压抑着即将爆发的情欲，那是被压抑了太久的野兽在低吼。
沈如卿没有回答。
她知道梦境有时间限制，这一次，她要拿到更多。
凭着本能，她低下头，温热的唇瓣轻轻印上了他滚动的喉结。
那是雄性最脆弱，也最敏感的地方。
与此同时，她的小手顺着他敞开的领口探入，在他结实滚烫的胸膛上肆意点火。
“唔……”
这一举动彻底击碎了苍珏引以为傲的自制力。
“既然来了，就别想跑。”
他低吼一声，猛地翻身，天旋地转间，将她死死压在身下。
铺天盖地的吻落了下来，不再是之前的试探，而是带着极强的侵略性和占有欲。
从唇角到锁骨，再到那一处处敏感的肌肤，他像是要将她整个人吞吃入腹。
他的手探入她的发间，迫使她仰起头承受这狂风暴雨般的索取。
两人的气息交缠，空气中弥漫着令人窒息的暧昧与火热。
沈如卿在梦中颤栗，他的强势霸道，让她几乎迷失。
就在苍珏的手指顺着她的裙摆上滑，准备彻底占有这个让他日思夜想的小妖精时……
时间到了。
怀中的温软突然化作一缕轻烟，在他指尖消散。

元帅府主卧。
苍珏猛地从床上惊醒。
“哈……”
他胸膛剧烈起伏，额角渗出细密的汗珠，黑色的睡袍凌乱不堪。
身体胀痛得厉害，那种即将爆发却被硬生生打断的空虚感，让他感到前所未有的暴躁。
怀里空荡荡的，只有空气中还残留着那股让他发狂的甜香。
“该死……”
他低咒一声，狠狠一拳砸在床上。
金色的眼瞳里满是欲求不满的戾气，指尖仿佛还残留着她肌肤细腻如脂的触感。
那种看得见摸得着，却在关键时刻吃不着的滋味，简直要逼疯他。
“小东西，真的很好，白日怯生生，晚上却大胆的入梦把我撩成这样。”他咬牙切齿，声音沙哑。
“你可一定要躲好，千万别让我抓到你，否则，我一定要让你哭着求饶。”
与此同时，沈家一楼客房。
沈如卿猛地从床上惊醒，整个人像是刚跑完一场马拉松。
她大口喘着气，脸颊烫得惊人，心跳快得几乎要跳出胸腔，她下意识地抬手捂住自己的嘴。
“嘶……”
轻微的触碰都让她感到刺痛。
她的嘴唇全是发麻肿胀的感觉，仿佛还残留着梦中那个雄性霸道，不留余地的吮吸感。
她低头看了一眼自己略显凌乱的睡裙，眼中闪过一丝后怕，又带着几分得逞的快意。
“这只狮子……比想象中还要饿啊。”

羞耻感让她想把头埋进被子里，但理智迅速回笼。
那是梦，也是交易。
“只要不亏，就是赚。”
content_en:
The temperature in her palm was so frighteningly hot that it almost burned her skin through the thin material of her nightgown.
"Is this a dream again?"
He whispered hoarsely, his voice suppressing the passion that was about to explode. It was the roar of a beast that had been suppressed for too long.
Shen Ruqing didn't answer.
She knew that dreams had a time limit, and this time, she wanted to get more.
Acting on instinct, she lowered her head and pressed her warm lips against his rolled Adam's apple.
That is where the male is most vulnerable and sensitive.
At the same time, her little hands penetrated along his open collar and set fire to his strong and hot chest wantonly.
"Well..."
This move completely shattered Cang Jue's proud self-control.
"Now that you're here, don't even think about running away."
He growled, turned over suddenly, and pinned her tightly under him while the world was spinning.
The overwhelming kiss fell, no longer the temptation as before, but with strong aggression and possessiveness.
From the corners of her lips to her collarbones, to the sensitive skin everywhere, he seemed to want to swallow her whole body.
His hands penetrated into her hair, forcing her to raise her head to bear the storm of demands.
Their breaths intertwined, and the air was filled with suffocating ambiguity and heat.
Shen Ruqing trembled in her sleep. His strong and domineering attitude made her almost lost.
Just when Cang Jue's fingers were sliding up the hem of her skirt, he was preparing to completely possess this little fairy who made him think about it day and night...
The time has come.
The warmth in his arms suddenly turned into a wisp of smoke and dissipated at his fingertips.
The master bedroom of the Marshal's Mansion.
Cang Jue suddenly woke up from the bed.
"Ha..."
His chest heaved violently, beads of sweat oozed from his forehead, and his black nightgown was in a mess.
His body was swollen and painful, and the feeling of emptiness that was about to explode but was abruptly interrupted made him feel more irritable than ever before.
His arms were empty, only the sweet fragrance that drove him crazy remained in the air.
"Damn..."
He cursed lowly and punched the bed hard.
The golden eyes were full of lust and anger, and the delicate and fat touch of her skin seemed to still remain on his fingertips.
The feeling that he could see and touch it, but couldn't eat it at the critical moment, was driving him crazy.
"Little thing, you're really good. He's timid during the day, but at night he's bold enough to tease me like this in his dreams." He gritted his teeth, his voice hoarse.
"You must hide well and don't let me catch you. Otherwise, I will make you cry and beg for mercy."
At the same time, the guest room on the first floor of the Shen family.
Shen Ruqing suddenly woke up from the bed, looking like she had just finished a marathon.
She gasped for air, her cheeks were incredibly hot, and her heartbeat was so fast that it almost jumped out of her chest. She subconsciously raised her hand to cover her mouth.
"Hiss..."
The slightest touch made her tingle.
Her lips felt numb and swollen, as if she still had the domineering and relentless sucking feeling of the male in her dream.
She glanced down at her slightly messy nightgown, a hint of fear flashed in her eyes, but also a bit of success.
"This lion...is hungrier than I thought."
The sense of shame made her want to bury her head in the quilt, but her rationality quickly came back.
It was a dream and a deal.
"As long as you don't lose money, you will make money."
